# Türkiye Seismic Intelligence & Resilience Platform

DepremNabız AI is open research software for earthquake catalogue analytics, Sentinel-1 acquisition
discovery, processed deformation-point exploration and urban exposure screening focused on
Türkiye. It does not predict earthquakes or provide official emergency guidance.

Canonical project page:
https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/turkiye-seismic-intelligence-resilience-platform/

Source:
https://github.com/FaramarzKowsari/turkiye-seismic-intelligence-resilience-platform
